subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word that can be used here based on the given context.**

We, as human beings, usually tend to forget that life itself is an accumulated process of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "learning."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"learning" **in the blank is to convey the idea that life is a continuous journey of acquiring knowledge, experiences, and understanding.
 
• The term** "learning"** emphasizes the ongoing process of growth, development, and gaining insights throughout one's life. (किसी व्यक्ति के जीवन भर विकास, विकास और अंतर्दृष्टि प्राप्त करने की सतत प्रक्रिया)
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct sentence**: *We, as human beings, usually tend to forget that life itself is an accumulated process of **learning**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Recalling: **to bring the memory of a past event into your mind. (किसी पुरानी घटना की स्मृति को अपने मन में लाना)
 
• **Remembering: **to have somebody/something in your mind or to bring somebody/something back into your mind. (व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का ध्‍यान रहना या उसे याद करना)
 
• **Testing: **a short exam to measure somebody’s knowledge or skill in something. (किसी विषय में किसी के ज्ञान या कौशल को मापने के लिए आयोजित लघु परीक्षा; परीक्षण, टेस्‍ट)
